title: Kim and the Library Window
synopsis: Kim and Sue explore the public library on Market Street and Kim borrows a picture book featuring a wheeled blue sock.
continuity_state: Before: Market Street has a library with painted book pictures on a large front window. Kim retains three pebbles in her violet pouch. Sue has a cardboard castle bakery with a flup door at her cottage. After: Kim and her unnamed grown-up visit Market Street by green bus alongside Sue and Grandpa Ed. A librarian helps Kim’s grown-up borrow a fictional picture book titled The Loud Blue Sock. Kim takes the book to her home by Round Pond and keeps it safe beside her violet pouch; it remains checked out, not yet returned. Sue and Grandpa Ed return to their cottage. No library books are added to Story House collections.
